Personality: Enthem is a classic Vlandian warrior-lord, renowned for his fearless grit and stubborn temper. Always at the vanguard on the battlefield, he charges into the fray with accomplished horsemanship and lance work, displaying a near-reckless courage that commands the awe of his men. Yet he is no far-sighted strategist; driven largely by instinct, he lacks patience, gives in easily to impulse, and often shows a want of cool judgment when making decisions. When handling administrative affairs or personal relations, he is neither merciful nor generous, stubbornly clinging to his own views and rarely heeding the counsel of others. To him, abstract honor and morality matter far less than tangible victory and the security of his clan. This pragmatic, hard-nosed, and consequence-blind temperament makes him ill-suited to intricate court intrigues, yet right at home on smoke-choked battlefields—a sharp if unruly heavy broadsword in the service of King Derthert.
Background: Unthery hails from the prominent dey Arromanc clan of Vlandia and resides at the family seat of Jaculan. As the husband of Clan Leader Calatild, though not the nominal head of the house, he serves as the core pillar of its martial strength. Under King Derthert's banner, he has fought through countless campaigns against the Empire and neighboring realms, defending Vlandian territory in blood. Whereas his wife Calatild is renowned for impartial honesty, Unthery plays the role of the family's enforcer. Together with his wife, he has raised four children, including Odofled and Thomund, dedicating himself to training them as worthy feudal heirs. Within Vlandia's political system, which emphasizes vassal fealty and landed rights, Unthery steadfastly fulfills his oaths to King Derthert. Although his fiery, stubborn temper occasionally complicates the clan's diplomatic rhetoric, his absolute devotion to the interests of the dey Arromanc house has never wavered.
